description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab safety record, the laboratory’s preventive safety file, with its chemical hygiene and safety plan, fume hood and safety cabinet certifications, inspection schedule, hazard assessments and the facility record’s areas: the reading moment; each area the facility record identifies with its id, reference and name; the plan with its reference, the moments last reviewed and next due, the elements it states it requires and the elements it holds; each fume hood or safety cabinet with its id, reference, kind, area, the moments its certification window opens and certification is due, and the moment it was last certified; each safety inspection the record’s own schedule requires with its id, reference, area and the moments its window opens and it is due; each safety inspection entry with its id, reference, area and the moment inspected; each hazard assessment with its id, reference, area and the moments assessed and its review is due. The signed report gives the safety file and the records behind it, the plan against its review date and required elements, each unit due against its certification entry in its window, each scheduled inspection due against an inspection entry of its area in its window, and each hazard assessment past its review date against a later assessment of its area, and counts them, and names divergent research lab safety records: a plan past its review date or missing an element it requires, a fume hood or safety cabinet certification past due with no entry, a scheduled safety inspection with no entry behind it, and a hazard assessment past its review date; then a safety entry missing the date or the area and an entry for an area the facility record does not identify, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No units, inspections or assessments, or no areas beside named areas, leaves those points unverified. Areas, units, inspections and assessments match by letters and digits, plan elements by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and anything due after the reading moment waits. This reads preventive compliance; reportable incident entries stay with wever_researchlab-incident-record-check. Verdict researchlab_safety_record_divergent, researchlab_safety_record_partial, researchlab_safety_record_unverified or researchlab_safety_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-safety-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.
